description: This file defines the AIConfiguration class within the WPEFramework::Plugin namespace, including its member functions and variables related to AI system configuration parameters.

classes.name: AIConfiguration
classes.description: Class encapsulating AI system configuration parameters and methods to access and initialize them.

methods.name: AIConfiguration
methods.description: Constructor for AIConfiguration class.

methods.name: virtual ~AIConfiguration
methods.description: Destructor for AIConfiguration class.

methods.name: initialize
methods.description: Initializes the AIConfiguration object, likely reading configuration data.

methods.name: getContainerConsoleLogCap
methods.description: Returns the console log capacity for the container.

methods.name: getAppsCpuSet
methods.description: Returns the CPU set assigned to AI applications.

methods.name: getNonHomeAppMemoryLimit
methods.description: Returns the memory limit for non-home AI applications.

methods.name: getNonHomeAppGpuLimit
methods.description: Returns the GPU memory limit for non-home AI applications.

methods.name: getVpuAccessBlacklist
methods.description: Returns the list of blacklisted VPU access entries.

methods.name: getAppsRequiringDBus
methods.description: Returns the list of applications requiring D-Bus.

methods.name: getMapiPorts
methods.description: Returns the list of MAPI ports.

methods.name: getResourceManagerClientEnabled
methods.description: Indicates if the resource manager client is enabled.

methods.name: getGstreamerRegistryEnabled
methods.description: Indicates if GStreamer registry is enabled.

methods.name: getSvpEnabled
methods.description: Indicates if SVP (Super Video Processor) is enabled.

methods.name: getEnableUsbMassStorage
methods.description: Indicates if USB mass storage is enabled.

methods.name: getIPv6Enabled
methods.description: Indicates if IPv6 is enabled.

methods.name: getIonHeapDefaultQuota
methods.description: Returns the default quota for Ion heap.

methods.name: getDialServerPort
methods.description: Returns the port number for the dial server.

methods.name: getDialServerPathPrefix
methods.description: Returns the path prefix for the dial server.

methods.name: getDialUsn
methods.description: Returns the dial USN string.

methods.name: getIonHeapQuotas
methods.description: Returns a map of Ion heap quotas.

methods.name: printAIConfiguration
methods.description: Prints the current AI configuration.

methods.name: readFromCustomData
methods.description: Reads configuration data from custom data source.

methods.name: readFromConfigFile
methods.description: Reads configuration data from a configuration file.

methods.name: getPreloads
methods.description: Returns the list of preload applications or libraries.

methods.name: getEnvs
methods.description: Returns environment variables related to AI configuration.
